note: Baseline global defaults. MAPE=4.09, model over-predicts holdout (actual ~10 bbl/mo).
d_min=0.03 — lowered to match flat tail, but MAPE worsened to 4.31. Model needs steeper decline, not flatter.
d_min=0.10 — steeper terminal decline brings predictions closer to actual 10 bbl/mo tail. MAPE improved 4.09→1.47.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 — no change, optimizer converges to same solution regardless of initial qi guess.
di_initial=0.80 — no change, optimizer converges to same solution regardless of initial di guess.
outlier_threshold=0.15 — marginal improvement. MAPE 1.47→1.45. More aggressive outlier removal slightly helps.
smoothing_window=5 — no change from v6 baseline.
b_initial=1.0 — no change, optimizer converges regardless of b starting point.
significance_threshold=0.30 — worse. Including more phases adds noise. MAPE 1.45→1.58.
significance_threshold=0.75 — big improvement! Filtering more insignificant phases (low-vol restarts) lets model focus on primary decline. MAPE 1.45→0.54.
